market_definition: The transfer adhesive tapes market comprises carrierless adhesive layers supplied on a release liner that transfer to a substrate without a permanent backing. It measures sales of finished adhesive transfer tapes for laminating, mounting and assembly. BY ADHESIVE CHEMISTRY: Acrylic, Rubber, Silicone. BY THICKNESS: Thin (< 50 µm), Medium (50–150 µm), Thick (> 150 µm). BY RELEASE LINER: Paper, PET / Film. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Building & Construction, Electronics & Electrical, Packaging & Logistics, Medical & Hygiene, Paints, Coatings & Surface Finishing, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Double-sided tapes with carriers; adhesive films and webs; thermally conductive tapes; liner-only release materials. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
